# Copilot instructions for this workbench

This workbench contains one extracted component and only what it needs to compile and test.
Work on that component. Do not change `src/app/app.module.ts`, `src/app/app.component.*`,
`package.json` or `angular.json`; they are generated by the workbench and are overwritten on
reintegration. Do not add dependencies.
